properties.rollback_state_en: Every AI-layer component on this feature is installable and removable under the L1 reversible-prototype rule and never blocks the continuous route; once removed the feature reverts to a multi-channel commercial foyer with no spending, booking or registration threshold, with the tactile band, engraved wayfinding, staffed help position and cash-and-staff channel left in place — a decommissioning plan containing any item that removes a non-AI channel triggers the R-12 stop condition. It carries OP-04, the continuity-breakpoint joint test point, registered at gate G0 with `ai_off_continuity_status` reading `premise_unproven_pending_site_audit` — the feature is held at the site-audit step and may not skip it. The Every-Sense service desk installed on it has a higher enablement gate, G3, registered in the `service_desk` attribute group.
properties.next_review_trigger_zh: 所属工作包停止条件任一成立（JZ-04：等价支付、人工服务或申诉链失效）时立即复审；进入 L4b 有期限常态运行后，按 R-11 到期未复审规则在 `review_due` 到期前完成三方复核；运行声明的 `as_of_date` 晚于 `review_due` 即立即按 L0 对待。

properties.service_desk_sequence_rule_zh: 四个位序不可调换：人工窗口先于一切 AI 构件设立，退出回执位永远在最后一步之后仍然在场。顺序是判据而不是布置建议。
properties.service_desk_sequence_rule_en: The four stations may not be rearranged: the staffed window stands before any AI component, and the exit-receipt station remains present after the last step. The order is a criterion, not a layout suggestion.
properties.service_desk_enablement_gate_note_zh: 服务桌是面向公众的商业前厅界面，属开放空间构件；四道闸门缺一不可，未通过 G3 独立复核不进入开放空间。开办条件七项的现状登记见 `visual/assets/service-desk-gonogo.json`，当前结论为 no-go。
properties.service_desk_enablement_gate_note_en: The desk is a public-facing commercial foyer interface and therefore an open-space component; all four gates are required and nothing enters open space before G3. The seven readiness conditions are registered in `visual/assets/service-desk-gonogo.json`, where the current verdict is no-go.
properties.service_desk_rollback_state_zh: 四位序中只有 AI 开关位属 AI 层。G3 结论若为「关闭 AI 层保留服务」，AI 开关位停用而人工窗口、多通道信息位与退出回执位继续运行；任何退役方案含撤除非 AI 通道的条目，即触发 R-12 退役连带撤除的停止条件，方案退回重编，撤除与验收的证据分离、非 AI 通道存续证据单独归档。撤除后本要素恢复为不设消费门槛的停留空间，`stay_without_purchase` 承诺不随构件撤除而解除。
properties.service_desk_rollback_state_en: Of the four stations only the AI switch belongs to the AI layer. Where G3 concludes close the AI layer and retain the service, the AI switch is disabled while the staffed window, multi-channel information point and exit-receipt station keep running; a decommissioning plan containing any item that removes a non-AI channel triggers the R-12 stop condition, sending the plan back for redrafting with removal evidence separated from acceptance evidence and channel-survival evidence archived on its own. Once removed the feature reverts to stopping space with no spending threshold, and the `stay_without_purchase` commitment is not released with the components.

properties.name_zh: 主脊中北段停靠与安静恢复公共空间
properties.name_en: Spine Mid-North Stop and Quiet Recovery Public Space
properties.design_role_zh: 主脊中北段停靠点，补足公共界面带与众智园之间的休息、求助与安静恢复间距。
properties.usage_note: Conceptual public-space envelope only; not an approved plaza boundary, operating permit, or cleared land-use decision.
properties.accountable_role_zh: 无障碍、交通与场地运营专业人员、产品设计、安全与维护人员（未来经授权）
properties.accountable_role_en: Accessibility, transport, and site-operations professionals; Product design, safety, and maintenance personnel (future, authorised)
properties.rollback_state_zh: 其上的 AI 层构件按 L1 可逆原型口径全部可安装可撤除且不阻断连续路径；撤除后本要素恢复为主脊中北段的停靠与安静恢复空间，触觉引导带、铸刻导视、人工求助位与现金人工通道不随之撤除——任何退役方案含撤除非 AI 通道的条目即触发 R-12 停止条件。本要素未挂载任何独立完成节点，其设计动作属 JZ-01 通用可达底线审计；按「先审计、再可逆试验、后专业深化」，最早闸门为 G0。
properties.rollback_state_en: Every AI-layer component on this feature is installable and removable under the L1 reversible-prototype rule and never blocks the continuous route; once removed the feature reverts to the central-north spine stop and quiet-recovery space, with the tactile band, engraved wayfinding, staffed help position and cash-and-staff channel left in place — a decommissioning plan containing any item that removes a non-AI channel triggers the R-12 stop condition. The feature carries no Independent Completion Point; its design action belongs to the JZ-01 universal-access baseline audit, and under audit first, reversible trial second, professional development third its earliest gate is G0.
properties.next_review_trigger_zh: 所属工作包停止条件任一成立（JZ-01：路线冲突、替代通道或合理便利缺失；JZ-05：构件不可撤回、不可维修或阻断通行）时立即复审；进入 L4b 有期限常态运行后，按 R-11 到期未复审规则在 `review_due` 到期前完成三方复核；运行声明的 `as_of_date` 晚于 `review_due` 即立即按 L0 对待。
properties.next_review_trigger_en: Reviewed immediately when any stop condition of its work packages holds (JZ-01: route conflict, or a missing alternative channel or reasonable accommodation; JZ-05: a component that cannot be removed or repaired, or that blocks movement); Once at L4b time-bounded routine operation, the three-way review must be completed before `review_due` under R-11; an operating declaration whose `as_of_date` passes `review_due` is treated immediately as L0.
